description: Issue #839: the declaration-slot rule applies inside a DEFERRED handler body, not only inside bodies that run inline. `every 1 [ … ]` registers a handler whose block runs on a later tick, and a declaration inside it is still a declaration — phase-1 registration walks the whole program before any statement runs, so `define forward` there is `ol-reserved-word` and the handler is never registered at all. A `ProfileStatement` body is the enclosing kind an implementer is most likely to special-case, precisely because "handlers run later" invites deferring their registration. Paired with `core-language/procedures/nested-declaration-of-a-built-in-name`, which covers the inline-body half of the same axis.

diagnostics.message: forward is already part of OpenLogo. choose another name.
